blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — pegfilgrastim versus filgrastim dosing
stem: An adult receiving myelosuppressive chemotherapy asks how pegfilgrastim (NEULASTA) differs from filgrastim (NEUPOGEN). Which response by the nurse is accurate?

options.A: Pegfilgrastim is given once per chemotherapy cycle, whereas filgrastim is administered daily through the neutrophil-recovery period; both are separated appropriately from cytotoxic chemotherapy.
options.B: Pegfilgrastim is administered daily after chemotherapy, whereas filgrastim is given once per cycle, so their usual dosing frequencies are the reverse of each other.
options.C: Pegfilgrastim is routinely administered during the 24 hours immediately after chemotherapy, while filgrastim is intentionally given just before cytotoxic treatment begins.
options.D: Pegfilgrastim and filgrastim normally use the same once-per-cycle schedule, so dosing frequency does not meaningfully distinguish these two colony-stimulating factors.

rationale: Current NEULASTA labeling recommends a single 6-mg subcutaneous dose once per chemotherapy cycle and prohibits administration between 14 days before and 24 hours after chemotherapy. Current NEUPOGEN labeling recommends daily filgrastim beginning at least 24 hours after chemotherapy and continuing through the expected neutrophil nadir until the labeled ANC endpoint or maximum duration. Therefore A is correct.
educational_objective: Differentiate once-per-cycle pegfilgrastim from daily filgrastim and recognize required separation from cytotoxic chemotherapy.
source_document_title: NEULASTA (pegfilgrastim) and NEUPOGEN (filgrastim) — Full Prescribing Information
source_version_date: Current NEULASTA label accessed 2026-08-26; NEUPOGEN DailyMed updated July 23, 2026
source_locator: NEULASTA §2.1: 6 mg once per chemotherapy cycle; do not administer 14 days before through 24 hours after chemotherapy. NEUPOGEN §2.1: 5 mcg/kg/day, at least 24 hours after chemotherapy, daily through recovery criteria.
source_claim_supported: Pegfilgrastim is once-per-cycle; filgrastim is repeated daily; both require timing separation from chemotherapy.

candidate_reasons_resolved: Removed must/only cueing and balanced all options as complete schedule comparisons.
audit_note: Independent adversarial review confirms A uniquely matches current NEULASTA and NEUPOGEN labels; no residual absolute cue remains.
